d: It has been more than 24 hours since GTA 6 went live and millions of players are using the game to fulfill their personal fantasies. Some are painting their homes, cleaning their cars, petting dogs and cats and even freeing caged bears. Many influencers like iShowSpeed are doing GTA 6 Marathons, with iShowSpeed streaming for nearly 40 hours without taking a break. Players are even buying flowers and watching birds as this game brings an alternate reality to screens. Hem Kaur Saroya tells you more on Vantage on Firstpost.
